name: Hierarchical Latent Diffusion Models
definition: Denoising Diffusion Models trained with denoising score matching to model data distribution q(x0), sampling diffused input xt = αt x + σt ε, and training a neural network ψ to denoise.
summary: Hierarchical Latent Diffusion Models generate 3D scenes by training separate diffusion models on global, coarse, and fine latent representations, enabling complex open-world generation.
